verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents automations as Internal Agent tasks that run on a recurring schedule (e.g. every weekday at 9am) or on triggers. They are managed from a dedicated Automations page with templates for common setups. This is a first-party recurring-schedule capability, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration options (cron syntax, timezones, run history or failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am, or a trigger, like a GitHub PR merging
Set up automations on the "Automations" page. It shows all existing automations and includes templates for common setups.
Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.
